title: Bomb threats disrupt Europe flights

blocks.text: LONDON, United Kingdom — About 10 European flights were targeted by bomb threats on Tuesday, forcing the brief closure of a Warsaw airport and the scrambling of air force planes in Rome, authorities said. No explosives were found despite extensive ground searches after all the planes took off and landed safely in different European cities
